name: Novatek Microelectronics Corp.
description: Novatek Microelectronics Corp., a fabless chip design company, designs, develops and sells a range of display driver integrated circuits (IC) and system-on-a-chip (SoC) solutions in Taiwan, Asia, and internationally. The company offers display driver ICs for LCD displays, televisions (TVs), notebook computers, desktop monitors, cameras, tablets, PCs, automotive displays, smartphones, and wearable products. The company also provides SoC solutions, including timing controllers, LCD monitors, TVs, power management, and digital image controllers, as well as CMOS image sensors. In addition, it is involved in the sale, development, testing, and related consulting services for IC system application software. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.
